about.label: Studio
about.p1: I'm Nurullah Aydın. From Malatya, Türkiye. I've been building software for four years, and I keep growing in AI and the fields around it: an independent maker, one accountable practice. That practice is METEK Digital.
about.p2: I can stay true to the brand and design language you already built, or open a new one if you want, and put the work in front of you to judge.
about.highlight: See it. Try it. Like it. Then we talk.
about.p3: Let's build a website coded and designed for your business. Or automation that takes the work eating your time and gives you room for the rest, even a tea break.
about.doIntro: No ready package. Each job is built for your need.

items.title: Websites
items.body: Fast on phones, ready for search, clear path to quote or sale. Your brand should sound like itself on screen.

items.title: Automation
items.body: Bots and flows that shorten repeat work. Less daily load, more room for the real job.

items.title: Decide together
items.body: We talk through what doesn't fit. No rush sell. A clear next step.
